question: Which of the following is an example of Rabi crop?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Wheat.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The rabi crops are sown around mid-November, rather than after the thunderstorm rains are over, and harvesting begins in April/ May.
 
• The major rabi crop in India is wheat, followed by barley, mustard, sesame, and peas.
 
• The Kharif crops include rice, sludge, sludge, plum millet/ bajra, cutlet millet/ ragi( cereals), arhar( beats), soybean, groundnut( oilseeds), cotton, etc.
 
• The rabi crops include wheat, barley, oats( cereals), chickpea/ gram( beats), linseed, mustard( oilseeds), etc.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Difference between Kharif and Rabi crops:**

 
 
• Rabi crops are sown at the end of the thunderstorm or the morning of downtime.
 
• They're also known as downtime crops. Kharif crops are sown on the morning of the stormy season and are also known as thunderstorm crops.
 
• These crops bear a lot of water and hot rainfall to grow.
